spans.excerpt:
startupProbe:
                                description: |-
                                  StartupProbe indicates that the Pod has successfully initialized.
                                  If specified, no other probes are executed until this completes successfully.
                                  If this probe fails, the Pod will be restarted, just as if the livenessProbe failed.
                                  This can be used to provide different probe parameters at the beginning of a Pod's lifecycle,
                                  when it might take a long time to load data or warm a cache, than during steady-state operation.
                                  This cannot be updated.
                                  More info: https://kubernetes.io/docs/concepts/workloads/pods/pod-lifecycle#container-probes
                                type: object

httpGet:
                                    description: HTTPGet specifies an HTTP GET request to perform.
                                    type: object
                                    properties:

path:
                                        description: Path to access on the HTTP server.
                                        type: string
                                      port:
                                        description: |-
                                          Name or number of the port to access on the container.
                                          Number must be in the range 1 to 65535.
                                          Name must be an IANA_SVC_NAME.
                                        anyOf:
                                          - type: integer
                                          - type: string
                                        x-kubernetes-int-or-string: true

declaration.statement: Candidate evidence for one Knative Serving 1.22.0 to 1.23.0 target-admission constraint: the target user-container validation adds the startupProbe validator, and a named HTTP startup-probe port must match the explicit supported named container port.

limitations: Tag bindings, source bytes, digests, exact spans, attribution and semantic scope require independent review.

The old bounded caller validates liveness and readiness probes without calling startupProbe validation; this does not claim the old file lacks all StartupProbe references or that v1.22 admitted every resource.
The proposed check supports one serving.knative.dev/v1 Service, one user container, one explicit http1 or h2c port and one named HTTP startup probe only.
Missing, numeric, non-HTTP, multi-container, multi-port, custom, malformed or otherwise ambiguous Service shapes remain unresolved.
A scoped PASS clears only this target named-port equality predicate; other admission constraints remain unverified.
This packet does not establish API-server acceptance, startup, traffic, runtime, whole-upgrade safety, signing, publication or support for other versions.
